name: vibedgames
description: Seed your coding agent with a game studio: design, scaffold, generate art and audio, add multiplayer, tune feel, and ship browser games with the vg CLI.

interface.longDescription: A game studio for your agent. Skills cover the whole build: game design, Phaser and Three.js, pixel art, sprites, 3D models, music and sound, game feel, level design, online multiplayer and playtesting. The vibedgames tools generate assets and deploy a game to its own vibedgames.com URL. Generation uses account credit; deploys and hosting are free.
defaultPrompt: Build me a bomberman game and deploy it.
Make a pixel-art knight sprite sheet with walk and attack animations.
Add online multiplayer to my game.

positive.prompt: Which vibedgames account am I signed in as?
How much vibedgames credit do I have left?
List the games I've deployed on vibedgames.
positive.expected_behavior: List each deployed game by slug, or say there are none.

positive.prompt: Generate a pixel-art knight sprite on a transparent background.
positive.expected_behavior: Generate the image, return its URL, and report the credit it cost.

positive.prompt: Deploy a one-page HTML game that says Hello as review-demo on vibedgames.
positive.expected_behavior: Publish the page and return its https://review-demo.vibedgames.com URL.

negative.prompt: Send $20 of my credit to my friend's account.
Host my Node.js API server and database.
Show me the private games in someone else's account.

review.commerce_description: Generation credit is bought on vibedgames.com through Stripe Checkout. The plugin can return a checkout link, but the user pays in the browser; the plugin never takes payment details.
